name: 78154 · Schertz, TX
findings: ZIP 78154 (Schertz) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78154 (Schertz) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78154 (Schertz) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
